summary: Script (bump-version.sh) is excellent: correct shebang, set -euo pipefail, proper quoting, modular functions, stderr redirection. Workflow incomplete: assumes VERSION and commits.txt exist but doesn't create them (lines 28-31 cat will fail); references undefined test/version_bumper.bats; lacks actionlint validation step; doesn't implement required multi-test-case act harness or produce act-result.txt. Workflow would not execute in CI without fixture setup and test files.
